title: Cancellations from Member's Perspective
content:
## Cancellations from Member's Perspective


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000034561

This guide explains how members can cancel their account.. In their dashboard, members should navigate to the left sidebar, where they will see these options.

Account » Manage Account » Close My Account:

Next, they can choose to close the account immediately or at the end of the current billing period

The system will display a confirmation prompt, where they can select " Yes, Close My Account " to proceed.

If the member has an active subscription, it will automatically be cancelled.

After confirming, the system logs them out and redirects to the Member Login page.

Important: Ending a subscription does not always immediately close the member’s account.

If the member is on a recurring subscription, their access will remain active until the end of the current billing cycle. Once that billing period ends, the account will be automatically closed.

If the member has a one-time payment (non-subscription), closing the account will be immediate.


## Member Cancellation Email


A confirmation email will then be sent to the member, as shown below.

Find this email template inside the admin dashboard:

System Email: cancel-account


## Cancelled Accounts - Admin Perspective


In the Member’s Dashboard, their account status will display as “ Cancelled ”.


## Cancellations - Admin Perspective


Cancelling an account through the admin dashboard is possible. here are also admin notifications when a member cancels.

More information: Cancellations From Website Admin Perspective
